αἰειγενετάων: αἰειγενέτης — ever-born, everlasting; masc. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), epithet of θεῶν ’gods’
αἰνῶς: αἰνῶς — terribly, exceedingly (of an uncanny likeness); adv. · also general intensifier with a verb of emotion: αἰνῶς ἵεται ’is terribly eager’ · also modifying a verb of appearing: ’terribly, fearsomely’ (διεφαίνετο δ’ αἰνῶς ’glowed terribly’) · also intensifying a predicate adjective: ’terribly, wretchedly’ (αἰνῶς … εἵματ’ ἔχω κακά ’the clothes I have are terribly bad’) · also intensifying an adverb: ’terribly’ (ἄγχι … αἰνῶς ’terribly close’)
αἲ: αἴ (epic = εἰ) — if, would that; particle introducing a wish + opt. (αἲ γάρ ’would that’)
αἴθοπα: αἴθοψ — fire-faced, sparkling (of wine, lit. αἴθω ’burn’ + ὤψ ’face’); masc. acc. sg. · also of smoke, masc. acc. sg. (αἴθοπα καπνόν ’fiery smoke’)
αὐτοί: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a 2nd-person subject: ’yourselves’ (χαίρετε δ’ αὐτοί ’and fare well yourselves’) · also masc. nom. pl. with a 1st-person subject: ’ourselves’ (αὐτοί τ’ ἀμβαίνωμεν ’and let us ourselves embark’)
αὐτοὶ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’ · also intensive in agreement with an unexpressed ’we’: ’we ourselves’ (αὐτοὶ βῆμεν ’we ourselves stepped out’) · also in agreement with an unexpressed ’you’: ’you yourselves’ (αὐτοὶ δ’ ὀτρύνεσθε ’and you yourselves rouse yourselves’)
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο) · also reflexive intensive gen. sg. after a personal pronoun: σέο τ’ αὐτοῦ ’and of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’from it’, after ἐκ (ἐκ δ’ αὐτοῦ πείρατ’ ἀνήφθω, of the mast) · also masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive sense, ’his own’: αὐτοῦ ἐνεύναιον ’his own bedding’, αὐτοῦ βώτορες ’his own herdsmen’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun with a noun, ’his’: ὀστέα δ’ αὐτοῦ ’and his bones’ · also intensive gen. sg. with a demonstrative and noun: τοῦδ’ αὐτοῦ λυκάβαντος ’this very year’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’upon it’, after ἐπί (ἐπ’ αὐτοῦ, of a stool) · also gen. sg. pronoun of comparison after a comparative: ’than he’ (προγενέστερος αὐτοῦ ’older than he’) · also masc. gen. sg. after περί: ’about himself’ (περί τ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ περὶ πάντων) · also plain gen. sg. pronoun governed by ἄγχι ’near’: ’him’ (ἄγχι δ’ αὐτοῦ ’close beside him’) · also gen. sg. in a genitive absolute with a participle: ’with him himself still living’ (αὐτοῦ ζώοντος) · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, ’him’, governed by ἰθύς: ’straight towards him’ (ἰθὺς κίεν αὐτοῦ)
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτῶν: αὐτός — self; gen. pl.: ’their own’ (reinforcing a possessive) · also plain neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, not reinforcing a possessive: ’them’ (λήσομαι αὐτῶν ’I will forget them’, of things said) · also intensive with a noun: ’of the heroes themselves’ (αὐτῶν ἡρώων) · also with the article, ’the same’: τοκήων τῶν αὐτῶν ’the very same parents’ · also masc./neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, ’their’ (αὐτῶν τε φθογγήν ’their voice’, of the creatures on the far shore) · also gen. pl. ’our own’, possessive of the speaker’s group, with no other possessive (αὐτῶν … ἀφραδίῃσιν ’through our own follies’) · also masc. gen. pl., partitive: ’of them’ (οὐδέ τις αὐτῶν ’not one of them’) · also masc. gen. pl. personal pronoun after a preposition: ’them’ (δι’ αὐτῶν ’through the midst of them’) · also masc. gen. pl., ’their own’ with no possessive expressed (αὐτῶν κτήματα ’their own possessions’) · also masc. gen. pl. personal pronoun, depending on the adverb σχεδόθεν: ’near them’
αὔτως: αὔτως — just so, in this very way; adv. (ὣς δ’ αὔτως ’and in just the same way’) · also ’simply, without more’, of words alone (ἦ αὔτως ἐπέεσσιν ’or simply with words’) · also ’simply, idly, without more ado’, of sitting (αὔτως ἧσται ’sits idle’) · also ’without more, empty-handed’, of sending away with no gift (αὔτως ἀππέμψει ’will send us off with nothing’) · also ’to no purpose, idly’, of testing: αὔτως … πειρητίζων ’testing (each man) to no purpose’ · also ’merely, only’, qualifying a kind (ἦ αὔτως οἷοί τε … κύνες ’or merely such as … dogs’) · also ’idly, as he is’, of lying (ἦ αὔτως κεῖται ’or does he lie there idle’)
αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
βάλε: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβαλε): ’cast’ · also ’hit, strike’, with the person or part struck as object: ’struck’ (βάλε δεξιὸν ὦμον ’struck the right shoulder’)
βάλεν: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, in tmesis with ἀμφί: ’threw about’ · also in tmesis with ἐπί (βάλεν δ’ ἐπὶ ... ἑκάστῳ = ἐπέβαλε): ’threw over, cast upon’ · also in tmesis with παρά (πάρ … βάλεν = παρέβαλε): ’threw beside, set before’ · also without tmesis, with κε, unreal past: ’would have hurled’ (κε … βάλεν … ποτὶ πέτρας ’would have dashed her against the rocks’) · also in tmesis with ἐν (ἐν … βάλεν = ἐνέβαλε): ’cast into, sent upon’ (φύζαν … βάλεν ’sent panic upon’) · also plain aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, with no tmesis: ’let fall’ (δάκρυ χαμαὶ βάλεν ’let a tear fall to the ground’) · also plain aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, ’hit, struck’, the target or the weapon given: σκοπὸν … βάλεν ’hit a mark’, βάλεν ἰῷ ’struck with an arrow’
βουκόλον: βουκόλος — cowherd, herdsman; masc. acc. sg.
βῆ: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη): ’went, strode’
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γένοιτο: γίγνομαι — become, happen, turn out; aor. opt. 3 sg. (ὅπως ἄριστα γένοιτο ’how it might turn out best’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish with μή: μὴ ... φίλον γένοιτο ’may it not prove pleasing’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish after αἲ γάρ: αἲ γὰρ τοῦτο γένοιτο ’would that this might happen’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish after εἰ γάρ: εἰ γὰρ … ἔρις γένοιτο ’if only a contest might arise’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a fear clause after μή: ’lest it come to be’ (μὴ … ἀμφαδὰ ἔργα γένοιτο ’lest the matter become public’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with κε: ’it would be’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with ἄν: ’would become’ (ἡμῖν δ’ ἂν ἐλέγχεα ταῦτα γένοιτο ’and to us these would become reproaches’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish after a hortatory subj., no particle: ’let it arise, may it come about’ (βοὴ δ’ ὤκιστα γένοιτο ’and let a cry go up quickly’)
γέρον: γέρων — old man; masc. voc. sg. · also γέρων — old, aged (adj.); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σάκος: ’old’ (σάκος … γέρον ’an old shield’)
γέροντα: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. acc. sg.
γέροντος: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. gen. sg. (ἁλίοιο γέροντος ’of the old man of the sea’, θείοιο/τοῖο γέροντος ’of the divine/that old man’, epithets of Proteus) · also of an ordinary old man, with παλαιοῦ: ’of an aged old man’ · also ἁλίοιο γέροντος of Phorcys, the same epithet ’of the old man of the sea’ · also in apposition to a name: ’the old man’ (Λαέρταο γέροντος ’of the old man Laertes’)
γέρων: γέρων — old man; masc. nom. sg.
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γούνατ: γόνυ (pl. γούνατα) — knee; neut. acc. pl., elided (γούνατ’ = γούνατα)
γούνατα: γόνυ — knee; neut. nom. pl., epic γούνατα (= Attic γόνατα)
γρηῦς: γρηῦς — old woman; fem. nom. sg., epic (= Attic γραῦς), indefinite after εἰ μή τις: ’some old woman’
γῆρας: γῆρας — old age; neut. nom. sg.
δάκρυ: δάκρυ — tear; neut. acc. sg., used collectively: ’tears’ · also elided δάκρυ’ = δάκρυα, neut. acc. pl. · also literal sg. with an attributive adjective, not collective: θαλερὸν δάκρυ ’a swelling tear’ · also literal sg., no adjective: ’a tear’ (ἀπομόρξατο δάκρυ ’wiped away a tear’)
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δίφρου: δίφρος — stool, seat; masc. gen. sg.
δείδοικα: δείδω — fear; perf. 1 sg. with present sense, epic δείδοικα: ’I fear’
δεικανόωντ: δεικανάομαι — greet with a gesture, welcome (perhaps mockingly); impf. 3 pl. mid./dep., elided and uncontracted (δεικανόωντ’ = δεικανόωντο)
δεῖπνον: δεῖπνον — meal, supper; neut. acc. sg. (περὶ δεῖπνον ’about the meal’) · also neut. acc. sg. in apposition to a preceding object: ’as a meal’
δεῦρ: δεῦρο — hither, here; adv., elided (δεῦρ’ = δεῦρο)
δηρὸν: δηρόν — for a long time, long; neut. acc. sg. used as adv. (accusative of duration)
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: διὰ … τινάξῃ = διατινάξῃ ’shake apart, shatter’ · also + acc., causal, ’through, thanks to, by the aid of’ (διὰ … Ἀθήνην) · also as adverb/preverb in tmesis with κοσμηθέντες (διὰ … κοσμηθέντες = διακοσμηθέντες ’drawn up in divisions’) · also + gen., ’through, among’ (διὰ μήλων ’among the flocks’) · also prep. + gen., ’through’ (διὰ πτόλιος ’through the city’) · also in tmesis with ἧκε (διὰ … ἧκε = διῆκε ’shot through’) · also in tmesis with ἦλθε (διὰ … ἦλθε = διῆλθε ’went through’)
δολίον: Δολίος — Dolios, an old household slave, gardener of Penelope and Laertes; masc. acc. sg.
δολίος: Δόλιος — Dolius, father of Melantho; masc. nom. sg.
δοῖεν: δίδωμι — give; aor. opt. 3 pl., wish: ’may they give’ · also aor. opt. 3 pl. in a protasis after εἰ: ’if they should give’
δόμοισιν: δόμος — house, home; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), plural for a single dwelling
δόμους: δόμος — house, hall; masc. acc. pl.: ’halls’ (plural for one dwelling)
δώματα: δῶμα — house, dwelling; neut. acc. pl. (plural for a single dwelling): ’house, home’
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖαν: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; fem. acc. sg. δῖαν, here extended to the sea (ἅλα δῖαν ’the heavenly brine’) rather than a hero · also of a place-name: Λακεδαίμονα δῖαν ’heavenly Lacedaemon’ · also of Dawn: Ἠῶ δῖαν ’heavenly Dawn’ · also of the upper air: αἰθέρα δῖαν ’the heavenly upper air’
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
δῶκας: δίδωμι — give; aor. 2 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδωκας)
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’ · also with opt., in a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ … ὁμοφρονέοις … γένοιο) · also ὡς εἰ + opt., ’as if’ (ὡς εἰ … ἱκοίατο ’as if they had come’) · also ὡς εἰ, ’as if’, before a noun with no verb of its own (ὡς εἰ κέρα … ἠὲ σίδηρος ’as if horn or iron’)
εἰδῶ: οἶδα — know; perf. subj. 1 sg.: ’that I may know’
εἰπὲ: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. imper. 2 sg.
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’) · also in the idiom εἰς ὅ (κε) ’until’: εἰς ὅ κεν … μιγήῃς ’until you mingle with’ · also in the idiom εἰς ὅτε (κε) + subj., ’until the time when’ (εἰς ὅτε κέν … καθέλῃσι ’until … brings down’)
εἴπω: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 1 sg.
εἶδός: εἶδος — form, appearance, beauty; neut. acc. sg.; accented before enclitic τε
εἷλεν: αἱρέω — take, seize, catch; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable (= εἷλε): ’caught’
εἷλον: αἱρέω — take, seize, catch; aor. 3 pl. act., augmented (εἷλον = ἔ-ελον): ’they caught’
εὗρον: εὑρίσκω — find; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ηὗρον) · also aor. 1 sg.: ’I found’ (εὗρον ἔπειτ’ … ἑταίρους)
ηὔδα: αὐδάω — speak, say; impf. 3 sg., augmented (αὐ- → ηὐ-)
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before rough breathing, cf. ἔφαθ’) — and; connective particle · also with the relative ὅθι, no connective force: ὅθι θ’ ’where’ · also epic τε after a relative, no connective force (οὕς θ’ ’which’) · also epic τε after οὐδέ, no connective force: οὐδέ θ’ ἅλεσσι ’nor … with salt’
θάρσει: θαρσέω — be of good courage, take heart; pres. imper. 2 sg.
θανὼν: θνῄσκω — die; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having died, now dead’
θαύμαζε: θαυμάζω — wonder at, marvel; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐθαύμαζε)
θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θοῇς: θοός — swift; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇς (= Attic -αῖς)
θρόνους: θρόνος — chair, seat of honour; acc. pl.
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
θῆκεν: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg. · also ’make (someone a certain way)’, with double acc.: ’made him (taller)’
κίε: κίω — go, go one’s way; aor. 3 sg. (root aorist, unaugmented): ’went’ (the gen. Τηλεμάχοιο is governed by ἰθύς ’straight toward’, not by this verb) · also imper. 2 sg.: ’go!’
κίον: κίω — go, move; epic impf. 3 pl. (= ἐπορεύοντο), unaugmented · also κίων — pillar, column; masc. acc. sg., elided (κίον’ = κίονα): ’pillar’ (κίον’ ἀν’ ὑψηλήν ’up the tall pillar’)
καθαπτόμενος: καθάπτομαι — accost, address directly, fasten on with words; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
καλά: καλός — good, fine, beautiful; neut. nom./acc. pl.
καλὴν: καλός — beautiful, fair; fem. acc. sg.
καρπῷ: καρπός — wrist; masc. dat. sg. (distinct from καρπός ’fruit’) · also καρπός — fruit, produce; masc. dat. sg., dat. of cause or respect: ’with fruit’ (βρίθῃσι δένδρεα καρπῷ ’the trees are laden with fruit’)
κατ: κατά (elided κατ’) — down from, throughout; + gen./acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (κατ’ … ἕζετο = κατέζετο ’sat down’) · also + acc., of place, ’along’ (κατ’ ἠερόεντα κέλευθα ’along the misty paths’) · also + acc., ‘over against’ (κατ’ ἄντηστιν ‘right opposite’)
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (κατὰ πετράων ’down from the rocks’) · also + gen., ’all over, throughout’ (κατὰ σπείους κέχυτο ’lay spread all over the cave’) · also + acc., of the part grasped: ’by’ (κατὰ νῶτα λαβών ’taking him by the back’) · also + acc., ’on account of, on the business of’ (κατὰ χρέος ’on business’) · also + gen., ’down in, within’ (κατὰ σπείους κοίλοιο δέδυκεν ’is sunk in the hollow cave’) · also + acc., of the place struck: ’in, on’ (κατὰ δεξιὸν ὦμον ’on the right shoulder’)
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … ἐποτρύνῃ ’until … urges on’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κε πίῃ) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever, as soon as’ (ὅτε … κε θάνῃσιν; ἐπεί κε … λίπῃ) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κε … ἀκούσῃς) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κε λίσσηαι ’but if you beg’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καὶ νύ κε … βάλεν ’and she would have hurled’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κε θάνωμεν ’either we may die’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κε … μαχοίμην ’I would fight’) · also + subj. in a relative clause of purpose: ’who are to’ (οἵ κε … ἀγγείλωσι ’who are to announce’) · also + fut. indic. (or short-vowel subj.) in a main clause: ’will’ (αἶψά κε … ἀποτίσεται ’at once he will exact payment’) · also + aor. in a general relative clause: ’who would (decide)’ (οἵ κε … ἔκριναν) · also + opt. in a relative clause: ’whoever might’ (ὅς κε … πόροι ’whoever might offer’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κε … ἐντανύσῃς) · also + subj. in an indirect clause after ὅττι: ’what … may’ (ὅττι κε κέρδος … ἐγγυαλίξῃ ’what gain … may grant’)
κεφαλλήνων: Κεφαλλῆνες — the Cephallenians, Odysseus’ island people; masc. gen. pl.
κεῖται: κεῖμαι — lie; pres. 3 sg., used of the dead: ’lies (dead)’ · also in the idiom θεῶν ἐν γούνασι κεῖται: ’rests with the gods, lies in the gods’ hands’ (of an outcome, not of the dead) · also subj. (= κέηται): ’should lie’ · also plain pres. 3 sg. of stored objects: ’lies, is kept/stored’ (κειμήλια κεῖται ’treasures lie stored’) · also pres. 3 sg. of a living person in a settled, ongoing state, not of the dead nor of an outcome nor of stored goods (ὁ μὲν ἐν νήσῳ κεῖται ’πάσχων’): ’remains, is stranded, dwells on’ · also of a place, ’lies, is situated’ (νῆσος ... κεῖται ’an island lies’) · also of an object: ’lies’ (ἀράχνια κεῖται ἔχουσα ’lies holding cobwebs’) · also of the spirit or heart, ’lies sunk (in)’: κεῖται ἐν ἄλγεσι θυμός ’the spirit lies in pains’
κλισμούς: κλισμός — chair, seat (lighter than the θρόνος); acc. pl.
κλυτὸν: κλυτός — famous, renowned, glorious; masc. acc. sg.
κομέεσκεν: κομέω — tend, care for; impf. 3 sg., iterative in -σκ-, uncontracted (= Attic ἐκόμει): ’used to tend’
κρέα: κρέας — meat, flesh; neut. acc. pl., uncontracted (= Attic κρέα contr.)
κρατέουσιν: κρατέω — rule, hold sway; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κρατοῦσιν)
κύσε: κυνέω — kiss; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκυσε)
κῆπον: κῆπος — garden, orchard; masc. acc. sg.
κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect (φίλον κῆρ ’in his own heart’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a verb: κῆρ ἤθελε ’my heart wished’ · also κήρ — death-fate, doom; fem. acc. sg., elided (κῆρ’ = κῆρα): ’death-fate’ (θάνατον καὶ κῆρ’ ’death and doom’) · also neut. acc. sg., after ἀμφί: ’around the heart’ · also neut. acc. sg., direct object with a predicate adjective: ’heart’ (κῆρ ἀτέραμνον ἔθηκαν ’made the heart unyielding’)
λαέρτην: Λαέρτης — Laertes, father of Odysseus; acc. sg.
λαέρτης: Λαέρτης — Laertes, father of Odysseus; masc. nom. sg.
λαβὼν: λαμβάνω — take, take hold of; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’ (γούνων λαβών ’clasping the knees’, gen. of the part grasped)
λαῶν: λαός — people, host; masc. gen. pl., governed by ἄνασσε ’was lord over’ · also gen. with a noun: ’of the people’ (ποιμένα λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’) · also governed by ἐκ: ἔκ ... λαῶν ’from the people’ · also partitive gen. after a relative: οἵ ... λαῶν ἡμετέρων ’those of our people who’ · also partitive gen. after an adjective of rank: πάντων ἀριδείκετε λαῶν ’most distinguished of all the people’ · also gen. governed by πρόσθεν: ’before (the city and) the people’ · also gen. governed by φείδεο ’spare’: ’spare your people’ (φείδεο λαῶν σῶν)
λευκῷ: λευκός — white, bright, clear; neut. dat. sg. (ὕδατι λευκῷ ’with bright water’) · also masc. dat. sg., instrumental, agreeing with ὀδόντι: ’with a white tusk’
λοῦσεν: λούω — bathe, wash; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’bathed’
λύτο: λύω — loose, undo; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented root-aorist form (= ἐλύθη): ’was loosed, gave way’
λώβη: λώβη — outrage, shameful abuse, disgrace; fem. nom. sg.
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέγεθός: μέγεθος — size, stature; neut. nom./acc. sg.
μέλε: μέλω — be a care to (someone); aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔμελε(ν)), + dat.: ’was a care to’ · also μέλος — limb; neut. acc. pl., elided (μέλε’ = μέλεα)
μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’) · also in a question expecting the answer ’no’, after ἦ: ἦ μή … φάσθ’ ἔμμεναι; ’surely you do not say … are?’ · also ’lest’ + subj. after a past verb of urging (κελόμην … μή … λάθηται ’I urged … lest he forget’) · also in a condition, ’if … not’ (εἰ … μή τίς σε βιάζεται) · also with an infinitive used as an imperative, a prohibition: μή μ’ … καταλείπειν ’do not leave me’ · also negating a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’so that … not’ (ἵνα μή τι … ἀλγήσετε ’so that you may not suffer’) · also with the optative, a negative wish: ’may … not’ (μή … ἀντιβολήσαις) · also ὡς ἂν μή + subj., negative purpose: ’so that … not’ (ὡς ἂν μή σε κατατρύχῃ ’so that he may not wear you out’) · also + subj. giving the content of an oath, ’that no one …’ (ὀμόσσατε … μή τις … πλήξῃ ’swear that no one strike’) · also μή + subj. standing alone as a warning, ’lest’ (μή τίς τοι … ἀναστῇ ’lest someone rise up against you’) · also μή + fut. indic. in a fear clause: ’lest, I fear’ (μή τίς … νεμεσήσεται ’lest anyone resent’)

μείζονα: μείζων — greater, larger; comparative of μέγας; masc. acc. sg.
μεγάροις: μέγαρον — hall, great room; neut. dat. pl.: ‘in the halls’
μεγάροισι: μέγαρον — hall; dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
μεγαλήτορα: μεγαλήτωρ — great-spirited, great-hearted; masc. acc. sg. (of Odysseus) · also of θυμός, ’great-hearted’ (μεγαλήτορα θυμόν)
μειλιχίοις: μειλίχιος — gentle, soothing; masc. dat. pl., with ἐπέεσσιν
μελόντων: μέλω — be a care to, concern; pres. imper. 3 pl. (also μελέτωσαν) ’let them be a care’
μεμαῶτες: μέμονα — be eager, strive; perf. part. masc. nom. pl., epic (μεμαώς, μεμαῶτ-), with present sense: ’eager’
μετέειπε: μετεῖπον — speak among, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic μετεῖπε)
μετέειπεν: μετεῖπον — speak among, address a group (poetic aor., defective); aor. 3 sg.: ’spoke among them’
μετείην: μέτειμι — be among, be with (μετά + εἰμί) + dat.; pres. opt. 1 sg.: ’I should be among’
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · with acc. also ’in quest of, in search of’ (μετὰ χαλκόν ’after bronze’) · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also adverb, ’among them, in their midst’: μετὰ δὲ πρέπει ἀγρομένοισιν ’and he stands out among the gathered’ · also as preverb in tmesis (μετὰ … βεβήκει = μεταβεβήκει ’had moved on, passed on’) · also a plain adverb, ’afterwards’ (μετὰ γάρ τε καὶ ἄλγεσι τέρπεται ἀνήρ ’for afterwards a man takes pleasure even in pains’; some take it as ’among’ with ἄλγεσι) · also + dat. of the mind, ’in’ (μετὰ φρεσὶ σῇσι ’in your mind’) · also + dat. of the hands, ’in’ (μετὰ χερσὶν ἐνώμα ’was turning in his hands’)
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μνηστῆρες: μνηστήρ — suitor; nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’suitors!’
μοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., accented μοί before the enclitic that follows: ’to me, for me’
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of the person affected, ’from my …’ (μοι βλεφάρων ἐξέσσυτο ὕπνος ’sleep rushed out from my eyelids’) · also dat. of possession with εἰμί: ’who are mine’ (οἵ μοι ἔασιν ’who are mine’) · also dat. of possession with a noun: ’my’ (νηῦς δέ μοι ἥδ’ ἕστηκεν ’this ship of mine stands’)
μύθοισιν: μῦθος — word, speech; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μὴ: μή — not; negative particle in wishes, prohibitions, and purpose/fear clauses · also negating a conditional clause after εἰ: εἰ μὴ ’if not, unless’ · also negating a generic relative clause with the opt.: ὃς μὴ … ἐλάσειε ’whoever did not drive off’ · also ’lest’ in a warning, + 2 sg. fut./subj.: μὴ … ἀποτίσεαι ’lest you pay for it’ · also + inf., negating an infinitive of advice that gives the content of a word: ’not to’ (ἔπος … μὴ πάντα μνηστῆρσιν ὁμιλεῖν ’a word, not to mingle in everything with the suitors’) · also negating a generic relative clause with the subj.: ᾧ μὴ πολλοὶ ἔωσιν ’who has not many’
ναιετάοντας: ναιετάω — dwell, be inhabited; pres. part. masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (contracted ναιετῶντας; prose says οἰκέω): ’inhabited’
νηυσὶ: ναῦς — ship; dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί)
νῆας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’) · also article-like with a numeral and noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’the’ (οἱ δὲ δύω σκόπελοι ’the two crags’) · also encl. dat. sg. of a thing, ’to/for it’ (δύω δέ τέ οἱ θύραι ’and it has two doors’) · also article-like with a noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’those, the’ (οἱ πέπλοι ’the robes’) · also dat. sg. of the giver with δέχομαι: ’from him’ (οἱ ἐδέξατο ’took from him’) · also encl. dat. sg. of the possessor with a body part: ’his’ (ἀνὰ ῥῖνας δέ οἱ ’up his nostrils’)
οἶκον: οἶκος — house, household (and its stores); acc. sg.
οἶκόνδε: οἶκος — house, home; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’towards’: ’homeward’
οἷ: οἷος — of what kind, such as; relative/exclamatory adj., neut. nom./acc. pl. οἷα, elided (οἷ’) · also orthotone dat. sg. of the 3rd-person pronoun (= οἱ): ’to him, to her’
οἷος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg. · rough-breathed οἷος is relative ’such as, of the kind that’ (οἷος Ὀδυσσεὺς ἔσκεν ’such as Odysseus was’) · also οἷος in an indirect exclamation, ’what sort of’ (οἷος κείνου θυμός ’what sort his spirit is’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐλὴν: οὐλή — scar, healed wound; fem. acc. sg. (grave accent mid-clause; not οὖλος ’thick, woolly’)
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάντη: πάντῃ — on every side, in every direction; adv. (Ionic -η)
πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv., with inf. like Attic πρίν · also a plain temporal adverb with a finite verb, not paired with an infinitive: ’formerly, in the past’ (αἳ πάρος ἦσαν ’who formerly were’) · also ’before (that)’ with a finite verb, in the past: πάρος δ’ εἰς Ἴλιον ᾤχετο ’before that he went to Ilios’ · also with a participle: ’formerly, before’ (πάρος περ ἐὼν ’though formerly being’)
πάσσονα: παχύς — thick, stout; epic comparative πάσσων (= Attic παχύτερος), masc. acc. sg.: ’stouter’
πάτερ: πατήρ — father; voc. sg. · also πατέρα, masc. acc. sg., elided (πάτερ’ = πατέρα): ’father’ (μητρὸς … πάτερ’ ’mother’s father’)
πάϊς: παῖς — child, son; nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παῖς)
πένεσθαι: πένομαι — busy oneself about, prepare, work at; pres. inf.
πένθος: πένθος — grief, sorrow; neut. nom./acc. sg.
πένοντο: πένομαι — labor at, be busy with, toil; impf. 3 pl.
πέφραδ: φράζω — point out, show, tell; reduplicated aor. 3 sg., elided (πέφραδ’ = πέφραδε)
πήχεε: πῆχυς — forearm, arm; masc. acc. dual, epic -εε (= Attic πήχει) · also masc. nom. dual, subject (πήχεε λευκώ ’the two white arms’)
παιδνὸς: παιδνός — young, small, boyish; masc. nom. sg., epic (cf. Attic παιδικός)
παιδὶ: παῖς — child, son; masc. dat. sg.
παιδὸς: παῖς — child, daughter; fem. gen. sg. (φίλης ... παιδός ’a dear daughter’) · also masc. gen. sg., ’son’ (παιδὸς ἐμοῖο ’my son’; τοῦ παιδὸς ἀγαυοῦ ’the noble son’) · also masc. gen. sg., ’boy, child’, with ἐόντος, gen. of the person described (παιδὸς ἐόντος ’when I was a boy’)
παντοῖαι: παντοῖος — of every kind; fem. nom. pl.
παραὶ: παρά (epic παραί) — beside, along; prep. + dat.
παρισταμένη: παρίσταμαι — stand beside, come to one’s side; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
πατέρ: πατήρ — father; masc. acc. sg., elided (πατέρ’ = πατέρα)
παύσαντο: παύω — stop; mid. cease (+ gen.); aor. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐπαύσαντο)
παῖδες: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. pl.
πεπνυμένος: πέπνυμαι — have one’s wits about one, be prudent; perf. part. masc. nom. sg. (trad. linked to πνέω ’breathe’, though uncertain), stock epithet: ’prudent’
περίφρων: περίφρων — circumspect, of sound understanding; fem. nom. sg., stock epithet of Penelope · also epithet of Arete: fem. nom. sg., ’the circumspect queen’ · also epithet of Eurycleia: fem. nom. sg., ’circumspect Eurycleia’
περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’) · also + gen., of place, physically ’around, encircling’ (περὶ σπείους γλαφυροῖο ’around the hollow cave’), distinct from the comparative ’beyond’ sense above · also + dat. in the fixed idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περὶ κῆρι τιμήσουσιν ’will honor him at heart’) · also + dat., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ χροῒ ’about the skin’) · also adverb of place, no case: ’round about’ (περὶ δ’ ἕρκος ἐλήλαται ’and round it a fence is driven’) · also + dat., of the thing fought over: ’over, for’ (περὶ κτεάτεσσι μαχειόμενος ’fighting over possessions’) · also + gen., of the thing fought over: ’over, for’ (fighting over a person)
πετάσσας: πετάννυμι — spread out; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., double σ metrical
πηνελόπεια: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope, wife of Odysseus; nom. sg.
ποιμένι: ποιμήν — shepherd; masc. dat. sg., in the standing royal title ποιμὴν λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’
πολέας: πολύς — much, many; masc./fem. acc. pl., epic πολέας (= Attic πολλούς)
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’ · also neut. nom. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun (πολλὰ ... δάκρυα ’many tears’) · also neut. acc. pl., plain attributive adj. (κτήματα πολλὰ ’many possessions’) · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’again and again’ (πολλὰ περιτροπέοντες) · also neut. nom. pl. as substantive, subject: οἷά τε πολλὰ γίγνεται ’as many things happen’
πολύμητις: πολύμητις — of many wiles, epithet of Odysseus (built on μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’); masc. nom. sg.
πολύτλας: πολύτλας — much-enduring; adj., masc. nom. sg., standing epithet of Odysseus (πολύ ’much’ + root of τλῆναι ’endure’)
ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
ποτιδέγμενοι: προσδέχομαι (epic ποτιδέγμαι) — wait for, await, expect; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.
ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί, here as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also a plain preposition + acc., no tmesis: ποτὶ τοῖχον ’against the wall’ · also + dat. ‘against’ · also + dat., ’on, upon’: ποτὶ χθονί ’on the ground’
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέειπεν: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
προτὶ: πρός (epic by-form προτί) — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also adverb ’besides, in addition’, or preverb in tmesis: ’in, to (oneself)’ (προτὶ … ἐκάλεσσας = προσεκάλεσσας ’called in’)
πρὶν: πρίν — before, until; adv./conj., + inf. (grave, mid-clause form) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article: ‘formerly, at first’, no infinitive · also bare adv. ’formerly’, no art./inf. · also + aor. subj., ’before’ (πρὶν … ἐπέλθῃ ’before it comes upon’) · also + opt.: ’before’ (πρὶν τλαίη ’before he would bring himself’) · also adv. with a finite verb, ’before that, sooner’ (πρὶν … ἀγείρετο ’before that … came gathering’) · also + fut. indic.: ’before’ (πρὶν … γαῖα καθέξει ’before the earth covers’) · also with a bare noun, the verb understood: ’before’ (πρὶν ὥρη ’before it is time’) · also adv. ’till then, before that’ in a clause with no finite verb (πρὶν δ’ οὔ τι νεμεσσητὸν κεχολῶσθαι ’till then it is no cause for blame to be angry’)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ῥαίοιτο πρὸς οὔδεϊ ’be dashed against the floor’) · also + dat., ’in addition to’ (πρὸς τοῖσί τε ὕπνος ’and sleep in addition to these’) · also + gen., of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς Βορέαο ’toward the North Wind’) · also + gen., in an appeal: ’by (your father)’ (πρὸς πατρὸς γουνάζομαι) · also as preverb in tmesis: με πρὸς μῦθον ἔειπε = με προσέειπε μῦθον ’spoke a word to me’ · also + gen., ’in the eyes of, with’ (πρὸς πόσιός τε καὶ υἱέος ’in the eyes of her husband and son’)
πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’
πτολίεθρον: πτολίεθρον — citadel, city; neut. acc. sg., epic lengthened by-form of πόλις
πτόλιν: πτόλις (epic by-form of πόλις) — city; acc. sg.
πυθέσθαι: πυνθάνομαι — inquire, learn, hear of; aor. inf. mid. πυθέσθαι, epexegetic: ’to hear of’ (κλέος ... πυθέσθαι ’fame ... to hear of’) · also aor. inf. mid., of purpose after a verb of sending: ’to inquire’ (προέμεν πυθέσθαι ’to send forth to inquire’)
πόνου: πόνος — toil, labour, hardship; masc. gen. sg., after ἄνευθε · also gen. after παύομαι ’cease from’: ’from toil’
πότνια: πότνια — lady, mistress (title of respect for a goddess); fem. nom. sg. · also of a mortal woman, a respectful title: ’revered, honoured’ (πότνια μήτηρ ’the honoured mother’)
πύλον: Πύλος — Pylos, city in the Peloponnese, home of Nestor; acc. sg.
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’ · also σός — your, yours; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (σ’ = σά): τὰ σ’ αὐτοῦ κήδε’ ’your own troubles’
σήματ: σῆμα — sign, token, mark; neut. acc. pl., elided (σήματ’ = σήματα)
σίτῳ: σῖτος — grain, food; masc. dat. sg.
σικελὴ: Σικελός — Sicel, of the Sicels; fem. nom. sg. Σικελή
στοναχῇ: στοναχή — groaning, sighing; fem. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with groaning’
στυγερὸν: στυγερός — hateful, loathsome; masc. acc. sg.
σφέων: σφεῖς — they, them (3rd-person pl. pron.); gen. pl., epic σφέων (= Attic σφῶν), possessive: ‘their’
σφεας: σφεῖς — they; epic acc. pl. pron.: ’them’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also as adverb, ’together’, or as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: σὺν … κάλυψε = συνεκάλυψε ’covered up’; σὺν … ἔπεσον = συνέπεσον ’fell together, clashed’ · also adverb ’along, with (us)’ construed with ἔχοντες, which takes the object (σὺν … χεῖρας ἔχοντες ’having hands along with us’)
σῆμά: σῆμα — sign, mark, grave-mound; neut. acc. sg.
σῇσι: σός — your (sg.); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς)
σῦς: σῦς — swine, pig, boar; masc./fem. nom. sg. · also masc./fem. acc. pl. (= σύας), object: ’swine’
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’ · also after ἤ ’than’, with no connective force: ἤ τ’ οἰωνοί ’than birds’ · also after ὅ ‘that’, with no connective force: ὅ τ’ οὐκέτι νόστιμός ἐστιν ‘that he is no longer returning’
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.; also relative: ’which’ (accented τά before a following enclitic) · also article-like with ἄλλα, ’the other (things)’ (τά περ ἄλλα ’in the other matters’) · also article-like before an adverb, ’the (things) within’ (τά τ’ ἔνδοθι)
τάδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also with a noun, neut. acc. pl.: ’these’ (τάδε δώμαθ’ ’this house’, plural for one dwelling)
τάχιστα: ταχύς — quick, swift; superl. neut. acc. pl. as adv. τάχιστα: ’most quickly’
τήνδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this (here); demonstrative pron., fem. acc. sg.
τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’) · also enclitic indefinite, adverbial without a negative: ’somehow, in some way’ (τοῦτό τί μοι κάλλιστον ’this seems to me somehow the fairest’) · also enclitic indefinite as an adjective after μή, accented before an enclitic: ’any’ (μή τί τοι … πῆμα ’any harm to you’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ὅπως, accented before enclitic μοι: ’any’ (τί … ἄλγος ’any pain’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ἤ, accented before the enclitic μοι: ’any’ (ἤ τί μοι … κειμήλιον ’or any treasure of mine’) · also the enclitic indefinite as a substantive object after εἴ: ’anything’ (εἴ τί μιν εἴποι ’whether she would say anything to him’)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τετύκοντό: τεύχω — make, prepare; epic reduplicated aor. 3 pl. mid. (with the accent of a following enclitic τε): ’they prepared’
τεύχε: τεῦχος — armour, gear (pl. τεύχεα); neut. acc. pl., elided (τεύχε’ = τεύχεα)
τηλέμαχον: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. acc. sg.
τισόμεθ: τίνω — pay; mid. exact payment; fut. 1 pl. mid., elided (τισόμεθ’ = τισόμεθα): ’we shall repay ourselves’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοιαῦτα: τοιοῦτος — such, of such a kind; demonstr. pron./adj., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’such things’
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. pl. τοῖο: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun/demonstrative); masc./neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic τοῦ): ’of it, of that’

ἔτ: ἔτι — still, yet; adv., elided (ἔτ’ = ἔτι)
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕζετ: ἕζομαι — sit down; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἕζετ’ = ἕζετο), in tmesis with κατά: ’sat down’ · also plain, no tmesis: ’sat’ (ἕζετ’ ἔπειτ’ ἐπὶ θῖνα ’then sat down on the shore’)
ἕζοντο: ἕζομαι — seat oneself, sit down; impf. 3 pl. mid.
ἕκαστα: ἕκαστος — each, every; neut. acc. pl. used substantivally: ’each thing, everything’ · also adjectival, with a noun: ’each piece’ (ὅπλα ἕκαστα) · also neut. nom. pl. in apposition: ’each’ (πεντήκοντα δ’ ἕκαστα ’fifty to each’)
ἕκαστοι: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. pl.: ’each of us’ · also masc. nom. pl., of a third party: ’each man’ (ἐπὶ κληῗσιν ἕκαστοι ’each man at his bench’)
ἕκαστον: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. acc. sg.
ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
ἠπείροιο: ἤπειρος — mainland, dry land; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ) · also introducing the first alternative of a question: ’whether’ (ἠὲ διεπράθετο … ἦ … ’whether it was sacked … or …’) · also ’than’, after a word of difference (ἀλλοῖος … ἠὲ πάροιθεν ’different than before’) · also ’than’ after a comparative or word of preference (βέλτερόν ἐστι … ἠὲ ’it is better … than’) · also introducing the first alternative of a command: ’either’ (ἠὲ σὺ πρῶτος ἔσελθε ’either you go in first’)
ἡδὺ: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’sweetly’ · also attributive, agreeing with a neut. noun: ’sweet’ (ἡδὺ ποτόν ’sweet drink’)
ἡμετέροισι: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἡμῖν: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; dat. pl. ’to us’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic ἠέ/ἤ) · also ’than’ after a comparative: κρεῖσσον … ἢ ὅτε ’better than when’ · also ’before’ after a verb of anticipating (ἔφθης … ἢ ἐγώ ’you got here before I did’) · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἔτι … ἦέ τις ’whether still … or someone’) · also ’than’ after a verb of preferring: βουλοίμην … ἢ … ἀνάσσειν ’I would rather … than rule’ · also introducing the first alternative of a deliberation: ’whether … or’ (ἢ ἐλάσει’ … ἦέ μιν ἦκ’ ἐλάσειε) · also ’than’ after a word of difference (ἀλλοῖον … ἢ Ὀδυσῆ’ ’another … than Odysseus’) · also the first of two alternatives: ’either … or’ (ἢ στοναχῆς ἠὲ κτύπου ’either groaning or noise’)
ἤγερθεν: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic -εν (= Attic ἠγέρθησαν): ’were gathered’
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἤλδανε: ἀλδαίνω — make grow, strengthen; aor. 3 sg., augmented (ἤλδανε)
ἤλιδα: Ἦλις — Elis (region of the Epeians); fem. acc. sg., with εἰς ’to Elis’ · also acc. sg. after παρά: ’past Elis’ (παρ’ Ἤλιδα δῖαν)
ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’) · also ’or’, the second alternative of a pair of questions with no preceding ἠέ: ζώει … ἦ τέθνηκε ’alive or dead’; ἢ ἔτ’ ἔχει … ἦ μιν ἀτιμάζουσιν ’whether … or’
ἦλθ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἦλθ’ = ἦλθε): ’he came, he returned’
ἰδέσθαι: ὁράω — see; aor. mid. inf.: ‘to see’
ἰθακήσιοι: Ἰθακήσιος — man of Ithaca; masc. voc. pl. · also masc. nom. pl., subject: ’the Ithacans’ (Ἰθακήσιοι εἰσορόωσι ’the Ithacans look upon’)
ἰθὺς: ἰθύς — straight; prep. + gen. (epic = Attic εὐθύς): ’straight towards’ · also adv., no case expressed: ’straight, straight on’
ἱκάνεις: ἱκάνω — come to, arrive at, reach; pres. 2 sg.
ἱκέσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; aor. inf.
ἴδεν: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= εἶδεν)
ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον) · also aor. 3 pl. (the same ending serves both persons): ’they saw’
ἴομεν: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 1 pl. (hortatory): ’let us go’ · also subj. in a temporal clause with ἄν/κε: ’we go, are going’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … ἀγροὺς ἴομεν ’while we go through the fields’)
ἵκοντο: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 pl.; with short ι (by metre) unaugmented; where the metre makes the ι long, augmented (the spelling cannot show it)
ἵστατο: ἵστημι — set, stand; impf. 3 sg. mid./intrans. (neut. pl. subject with sg. verb): ’were standing’ · also with ἀνά in tmesis, masc. sg. subject: ’stood up, rose’ (ἀνὰ … ἵστατο) · also impf. 3 sg. mid., masc. sg. subject, no preverb: ’stood’ (Τηλεμάχου πέλας ἵστατο ’stood near Telemachus’)
ὀδυσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; acc. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆα)
ὀδυσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆος)
ὀδόντι: ὀδούς (Ionic ὀδών) — tooth, tusk; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with a tusk’
ὀφθαλμοῖσι: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also article-like with an adjective and a name: ’the’ (ὁ θρασὺς Ὀδυσσεύς ’bold Odysseus’) · also article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’) · also distributive, masc. nom. sg.: ’the one’ (ὁ μὲν οὐρανὸν εὐρὺν ἱκάνει ’the one reaches the broad heaven’) · also article-like with a superlative: ’the worst’ (ὁ κάκιστος Ἀχαιῶν ’the worst of the Achaeans’)
ὁμηγερέες: ὁμηγερής — gathered together, assembled; masc. nom. pl.
ὁμῶς: ὁμῶς — alike, in like manner, equally; adv.
ὁππότε: ὁππότε (Attic ὁπότε) — whenever, when; conj., + subj. and κε in a general temporal clause · also introducing an indirect question, + pres. indic.: ’when’ (ὁππότε Τηλέμαχος νεῖτ(αι) ’when Telemachus is to return’) · also + subj. without κε, in a general clause: ’whenever’ (ὁππότε τις μνήσῃ ’whenever anyone mentions’) · also + opt., of what may happen in time to come: ’whenever he should’ (ὁππότε νοστήσειε ’whenever he should come home’) · also + indic., of a recurring case: ’whenever’ (ὁππότε θυμὸς ἄνωγε ’whenever the heart bids’) · also + fut. indic., after a verb of waiting: ‘for the moment when’ (δέγμενος … ὁππότε … ἐφήσει ‘waiting for when he will lay on’) · also + indic., of a single past occasion: ’when’ (ὁππότε … ἐέλπετο ’when she supposed’)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄλβια: ὄλβιος — blessed, prosperous; neut. acc. pl.: ’blessings’
ὄλυμπον: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, home of the gods; masc. acc. sg.
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj. · also temporal ’until’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἵκετ’ Ἀρήτην ’until he came to Arete’) · also ’until’ + ἄν and subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary verb: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … μένοιεν) · also temporal ’until’ + opt., of a hoped-for event (ὄφρ’ ἐξεμέσειεν ’until she should vomit out’) · also ὄφρ’ ἂν + opt., ’until … should’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἄγοιεν ’until they should carry’) · also temporal + subj. without ἄν or κε, ’so long as’ (ὄφρ’ ἀρετὴν παρέχωσι … καὶ γούνατ’ ὀρώρῃ ’so long as the gods furnish excellence and his knees are stirring’)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary-sequence verb: ὄφρα ... ἕλοις/ἵκοιο ’so that you might take/arrive’ · also temporal + indic., ’as long as’ (ὄφρα μὲν … ἦν ’so long as it was’)
ὄχ: ὄχα — by far, exceedingly; adv., elided (ὄχ’ = ὄχα), intensifying a superlative (ὄχ’ ἄριστα ’far the best’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg., elided (ὅδ’ = ὅδε)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’) · also with the optative, iterative in past time: ’whenever’ (ὅτε μέλλοι ’whenever he was about to’) · also with the pres. indic., ’whereas, when’ (ὅτε τ’ ἄλλοι ἅπαξ θνῄσκουσ’ ἄνθρωποι ’whereas other men die only once’) · also in ὅτε μή, ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ θεὸς … θείη ’unless a god should make’)
ὑμέας: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; acc. pl., epic ὑμέας (= Attic ὑμᾶς)
ὑπέσχετο: ὑπισχνέομαι — promise; aor. mid. 3 sg., augmented (ὑπο- + ἐ- elides to ὑπε-): ’promised’
ὕβριν: ὕβρις — insolence, wanton violence; fem. acc. sg.
ὕπερθεν: ὕπερθεν — above, from above, on top; adv.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., of manner: ’as’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I shall say’) · also comparative ’like’, standing before its noun (ὡς νυκτερίς ’like a bat’) · also ὡς ὅθ’ (= ὡς ὅτε), ’as when’, comparing with an occasion in the past (ὡς ὅθ’ ὑπὸ Τροίην ’as when beneath Troy’) · also introducing an indirect statement after a verb of saying: ’that, how’ (εἴποιμ’ ὡς … ἔρχομαι ’I might tell how I am coming’) · also ὡς ἄν + opt., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἄν τίς σε … μακαρίζοι ’so that someone … would call you blessed’) · also ὡς + participle, ’as one who’ (ὡς ἐκ θανάτοιο φυγόντα ’as one escaped from death’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν … ἔρχησθον ’so that you two may go’) · also ὡς = ’to, toward’ + acc. of a person (ὡς τὸν ὁμοῖον ’to the like’) · also exclamatory ὡς + finite verb: ’how’ (ὡς ὁ μολοβρὸς … ἀγορεύει ’how the glutton talks’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’ · also introducing a wish with the optative: ’so may…’ (ὣς ἔμ’ ἀϊστώσειαν ’so may they make me vanish’)
ὤλεσε: ὄλλυμι — destroy, ruin; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’destroyed’
ὤμοισιν: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
ὧδ: ὧδε — so, thus, in this way; adv., elided (ὧδ’ = ὧδε)
ὧραι: ὥρα — season, time of year; fem. nom. pl.
ᾤχετο: οἴχομαι — be gone, go, have gone; impf. 3 sg., augmented (οἰ- → ᾠ-): ’had gone’ · also of continuous motion, ’went about, kept going’ (κατὰ πτόλιν ᾤχετο πάντῃ ’she went everywhere throughout the city’)
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc. dat. sg.: ’his own (son)’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which; masc. dat. sg. (δοίη δ’ ᾧ κ’ ἐθέλοι ’give her to whom he wished’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg. (same form), agreeing with a neut. noun: πεδίοιο ... ᾧ ἔνι ... ’a plain in which is...’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἄχεϊ: ’her own (grief)’
ῥ: ἄρα (weakened ῥα, elided ῥ’) — then, indeed, so; inferential particle
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
